title: Regulated – notify with opt-out, transcript not retained
description: For meetings where participants have to be told and may object, and as little meeting content as possible is kept. Recording and transcription run from the start and stop when a participant objects: Meeting Consent mode Notify, a meeting may only use this mode or a stricter one (Opt-in), streaming clients without a consent step are refused, the Virtual Participant leaves after an objection, and evidence screenshots are kept. A Virtual Participant posts the notice in the meeting chat and reads objections there, and those said aloud and addressed to LMA, on every join; nothing is recorded or kept after an objection. Spoken objections are read from the meeting's own transcription, and are not read when Meeting Consent › Read spoken replies is off, which this preset leaves as it is. Stream Audio/Video and the Desktop Capture App show the notice for the LMA user to share in the meeting and capture from the start; an objection takes effect when the user records it with Participant objected. Clients that show no consent step (the Stream Audio embed, and browser extension and Desktop Capture App builds from before the consent step) are refused. See "Stream Audio/Video and the Desktop Capture App" in docs/meeting-consent.md. The transcript is deleted 15 minutes after the summary is written, and any recording that is still stored (an uploaded meeting's audio, for example) as soon as the summary is written; meeting audio, screen video from streaming clients and Virtual Participant meeting video are not recorded, personal information is redacted from transcripts (in en-US, en-AU, en-GB and es-US), the meeting chat is not added to the transcript, and Amazon Bedrock models run within this deployment's geography. The meeting assistant and summary settings it sets keep their shipped defaults: anyone in the meeting may make a request, answered from the current meeting only with no access to the meeting context and checklist; web search and the installed MCP servers are available; and new meetings start with no summary profile. Every other setting stays as it is. Some controls are stack parameters rather than settings, so they are not part of any profile and have to be set when the stack is deployed or updated: LogLevel (INFO or WARN; DEBUG logs meeting content), the retention periods MeetingRecordExpirationInDays, TranscriptionExpirationInDays, AudioRecordingExpirationInDays and CloudWatchLogsExpirationInDays, and EnableVideoRecording (meeting video from the Virtual Participant, the Desktop Capture App, the Stream Audio/Video page and the browser extension). See "Where meeting content is processed" in docs/infrastructure-and-security.md.

values.videoNoticeText: Video of the meeting, including shared screens and any visible camera feeds, is also recorded.
